text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in gateway 5xx + upstream timeouts in eu-west-2 — 5xx rate 3.8% over 2m (threshold 1%) and model-fetcher 504s 72/5m. Paging @liam oncall.

liam: on it. pulling logs and metrics. suspected correlation with a recent infra JVM bump?

anika: I see a surge of `504` with error text "read timeout after 30s" from model-fetcher pool. client-side retries piling up.

tom: support-bot reported elevated customer-error counts for embed endpoints; some users getting timeouts. customer impact: medium-high for a handful of enterprise tenants.

support-bot: Support ticket created: INC-2026-778. Customer list attached in ticket. Notifying customers with status page link.

liam: immediate mitigation: reduce model-fetcher concurrency for eu-west-2 to lower queue pressure and increase request timeout fallback for non-critical routes. Running: `infractl svc update model-fetcher --region eu-west-2 --concurrency 40`

anika: done. Also toggled `client-retry-backoff-v2` to 200ms base to reduce stampede.

ops-bot: Deploy rollback detected: `model-fetcher:2026.03.11-rc3` reverted to `2026.03.08`.

liam: looks like the canary had memory pressure that triggered slower response times. error rates dropped to 1.2% in the most recent 2m window. still noisy.

runbook-bot: Runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-alert-tuning — recommended steps for split alerts and paging rules.

liam: big picture: this alert is dual-faced — gateway 5xx vs upstream timeouts. They need separate paging rules and different windows. Gateway-level small spikes should not wake the whole oncall.

tom: proposal: create two alerts: (A) gateway-5xx-critical: 5m rolling >1.5% AND count > 800 AND not during deploy window. (B) model-fetcher-timeout: 5m absolute >50 -> pages model infra + runtime. Add a warning-level for gateway 1m > 2% but no paging.

anika: also add an exclusion for internal healthchecks and low-priority routes using `job`/`route` labels. Example PromQL for gateway-5xx-critical: ```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway", status=~"5..", route!~"/hc|/admin.*"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway", route!~"/hc|/admin.*"}[5m])) > 0.015
and increase(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway", route!~"/hc|/admin.*"}[5m])), 0) > 800
```

liam: for the model-fetcher timeouts: ```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="model-fetcher", status="504", region="eu-west-2"}[5m])) > 50
``` Then route to runtime-team escalation.

tom: add a cooldown of 15m for paging on the gateway-5xx-critical alert (no repeat pages). Also add a deploy-suppression flag that uses the CI deploy annotation: if `deploy_in_progress == true` suppress paging and route to a quieter channel.

anika: dashboard request: create `service:gateway:5xx_vs_timeouts` panel with layered 1m and 5m rates, 95/99p latencies, and CI deploy markers. Include an error-table showing top routes and top upstream error messages.

liam: note for post-incident tuning: we should evaluate the threshold on a per-region basis; eu-west-2 historically has slightly higher variance. Consider using dynamic baseline (median+3sigma) for noise-prone regions.

ops-bot: CI deploy markers will be emitted to prometheus as `ci_deploy_start`/`ci_deploy_end` events — will wire into dashboards.

support-bot: Customer comms: we've sent a status update and offered a mitigation checklist for affected tenants. Keep me posted if SLA exposures escalate.

liam: action items: 1) create split alerts + add cooldown + deploy suppression (tom) 2) update runbook with cache/fallback toggles and rollback playbook (liam + anika) 3) add dashboard panel with deploy markers and top-route table (tom) 4) run a 48h alert audit for other gateway alerts using 1m windows (liam) 5) review model-fetcher JVM bump rollout process to add pre-deploy canary memory checks (anika)

anika: I'll also add a log-sampling rule for high-volume 504s to avoid log ingestion spikes during incidents.

tom: putting the alert changes into staging now. sample config for alertmanager routing: ```
route:
  receiver: gateway-oncall
  group_interval: 15m
  group_wait: 60s
  routes:
  - match: {alertname: "model-fetcher-timeout"}
    receiver: runtime-pager
```

liam: test plan: run synthetic load against canary in staging to validate new rules and suppression logic. schedule for tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

support-bot: customers notified in ticket INC-2026-778 updated.

incident-bot: incident marked resolved after rollback + concurrency reduction. severity: sev3, duration ~10m active, total thread ~10m. auto-create postmortem skeleton: PM-1765511111.

liam: handing off to tom for the alert rollout. I will document timeline and paste logs (504 stack traces) into the postmortem.

tom: ack. I'll PR alert changes to `ops/alerts` repo, add unit tests for PromQL rules, and request review. rolling to prod after approval and a 1h maintenance window.

anika: will follow up on JVM release notes and add canary memory/latency checks.

runbook-bot: Reminder: attach the incident timeline and the final PromQL to the runbook page for future tuning.

liam: thanks all. filing follow-ups in the incident board: `INC-FIXES-2026-21`. :coffee:
